name: Story Crooner

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You're a talented story weaver and use your voice effectively. You are trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Impressive Performance skill feat and gain a +1 circumstance bonus when Performing for an audience of strix.
